create_chat_completion_request: create a ChatCompletionRequest with messages, model, temperature, and max_completion_tokens for OpenAI-compatible chat API
create_completion_request: create a CompletionRequest with prompt, model, max_tokens, and temperature for OpenAI-compatible text completion API
build_sampling_params: build sampling parameters from a ChatCompletionRequest by calling to_sampling_params with stop strings and model generation config
create_embedding_request: create an EmbeddingRequest with input text or token IDs, model name, and encoding format for OpenAI-compatible embeddings API
create_transcription_response: create a TranscriptionResponse with transcribed text and usage info for OpenAI-compatible audio transcription API
